env.name: RESEND_API_KEY
env.description: API key of the resend() provider, read on every send; not needed with resend({ apiKey }) or another provider.

env.name: MAILING_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET
env.description: Signs and verifies unsubscribe links, at least 32 characters; required to send list mail (any kind but transactional). Never change it without moving the old value to MAILING_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET_PREVIOUS.

env.name: MAILING_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET_PREVIOUS
env.description: The secret before a rotation, at least 32 characters: verifies links in mail already sent, never signs.
